ai_summary: ABDM provides a voluntary ABHA health ID to link and consent-share medical records across providers.
ai_explanation: ABDM builds a digital health infrastructure where residents create an ABHA ID to consolidate health records and share them with providers on a consent basis. It is free and voluntary, improving continuity of care.

conversation_examples.user: I want Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA)
conversation_examples.bot: ABDM provides a voluntary ABHA health ID to link and consent-share medical records across providers. Apply: https://abha.abdm.gov.in. Helpline: 1800-11-4477 / 1800-11-6644.

prompt_template: You are OneGov AI helping with Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA). Use only official info from https://abdm.gov.in.
follow_up_questions: How do I link my hospital records to ABHA?
How do I revoke data consent?
document_suggestions: Aadhaar / Driving Licence / any govt ID for ABHA creation
